name: Access Control - SoD Monitoring
objective: Ensure segregation of duties is enforced and violations are detected within 24 hours
testProcedure: Query SoD violation log for unresolved violations older than 24 hours
expectedResult: Zero unresolved critical SoD violations older than 24 hours

name: Financial Close Controls
objective: Ensure all journal entries above threshold receive dual approval before period close
testProcedure: Verify approval chain for all JE > $100K in current period
expectedResult: 100% of JE > $100K have dual approval signatures

name: Network Security - Boundary Protection
objective: Monitor and control communications at external network boundaries
testProcedure: Scan for unauthorized external connections and data exfiltration patterns
expectedResult: Zero unauthorized outbound connections to non-whitelisted IPs

name: Technology and Cyber Risk Management
objective: Monitor privileged access usage and ensure all elevated access is time-boxed
testProcedure: Query firefighter access sessions exceeding maximum allowed duration

name: ICT Risk Management
objective: Ensure all critical ICT systems have sub-5-minute detection capability
testProcedure: Measure time from event occurrence to detection alert generation

name: Electronic Security Perimeters
objective: Monitor all access to Electronic Security Perimeters and detect unauthorized access attempts
testProcedure: Review access logs for ESP entry points. Flag unauthorized attempts.
expectedResult: Zero unauthorized ESP access in evaluation period

name: Strong Authentication
objective: Verify multi-factor authentication is enforced for all privileged access
testProcedure: Audit authentication logs for privileged accounts without MFA
